values.note: All 42 sites first-come; campers pay at the campground fee station. Forest-wide order: no more than 14 days camping within any 30-day period.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/tsali-recreation-area ('42 campsites on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Campers pay fees at the campground fee station') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/alerts (order for the Pisgah, Nantahala, Uwharrie and Croatan NFs: 'Camping or maintaining a campsite in excess of 14 days within any 30 day time period' prohibited unless posted otherwise), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Nantahala NF (Cheoah Ranger District) off NC-28 on an arm of Fontana Lake, with a boat launch. Many sites fit small/mid RVs; a sharp interior curve hampers big rigs. Mountain-bike and horse trail hub (bikes and horses ride the loops on alternating days; per-person trail fee). --Claude
